NC-OVERBROAD-REPAIR deviation from the design prediction: the prereg anticipated >0 contamination for P2-STRUCTURE and 0 for P1/P3 where the schema is stable, but the runner observed 4/4 for every class. This is because each resource's distilled mechanism carries resource-specific literal postconditions (e.g. kind=user vs kind=post), so applying the target's postconditions to all mechanisms breaks the others regardless of class. The control still passes its intended sensitivity purpose (a global rewrite is detected as contaminated); it is a prediction miss in the control, not in the confirmatory metric and it did not affect the decision (invalid_reasons=[]).

Cost representation: the registered product counter is the equal-weight sum of integer {http_requests, retrieval_calls, verification_calls, repair_attempts} components. The repair is network-cheaper (fewer fetches) but pays one repair_attempt plus its probe fetch and additional retrieval/verification work, netting a ~5.3% product-counter regression that is stable across all three cold budgets. This is the preregistered MIXED-TRADEOFF tier, i.e. a bounded trade-off, not a strict cost win.

Scope: the substrate is a credential-free, in-process stdlib HTTP application on 127.0.0.1, not the live Web. Results bound C-DELTA-REPAIR only at this single credential-free-substrate ceiling; no live-site or cross-site generalization is claimed.
The scored run was executed once; V3 determinism is established by the byte-identical canary pair (as preregistered), not by repeating the 36-trial scored run.
unresolved: Whether any local-repair policy can be STRICTLY product-counter-cheaper than cold re-derivation on this carrier (all classes currently regress ~5.3%; the ratio is >1.0 at L=2 and L=3 and exactly 1.0 at L=4). One candidate direction: reduce the retrieve/verify overhead of the repair path so the saved fetches dominate the one repair_attempt.
Whether the MIXED-TRADEOFF holds on a materially different substrate (live sites, non-string ids, nested schemas) or is an artifact of this minimal JSON API.

Why NC-OVERBROAD-REPAIR contaminates P1/P3 as well as P2 (resource-specific literal postconditions); if a class-specific over-broad prediction is required in future, the control should be redesigned to isolate the schema-change class.

Whether the equal-weight product counter is the right product-economics constraint, or whether a network-weighted counter would be the appropriate decision surface (the current registered counter is the preregistered constraint and yields MIXED-TRADEOFF).
